Definition: {to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to call, read aloud, read out, shout; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to call, proclaim; 1a2) to read aloud, read out; 1b)(Ithp'el) to be summoned, be called
